visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a sage green hoodie and dark pants lies on a bed with pale yellow sheets and white pillows. He is crying dramatically with his hand pressed against his forehead. In the background, a white shelf is visible, filled with various plush toys and figurines. (2) The camera angle shifts to a tight close-up of the man's face, which is scrunched in an exaggerated expression of grief. A black-and-white filter with a heavy vignette is applied to the frame, emphasizing the dramatic tone of his sobbing. (3) A small, scruffy white dog climbs onto the bed and begins to nudge and lick the man’s neck. The setting remains the indoor bedroom with soft, natural light coming from an unseen window. (4) The shot changes to a medium view of two small dogs—a brown Yorkie and a white scruffy dog—sitting side-by-side on the bed. They stare directly into the camera lens with neutral expressions while the background remains the bedroom. (5) The man is now standing outdoors in a grassy backyard. He has his arms crossed and is looking down at the dogs. The background features a tan brick wall, a white fence, and green hedges under bright natural daylight. (6) A small Yorkie dog is seen defecating on the green grass. The man stands nearby, watching. In the background, there are orange trees with visible fruit and a neatly trimmed hedge. (7) The man bends over on the grass to pick up the dog waste using a black plastic bag. He then stands up and prepares to tie the bag while the dogs watch him expectantly. (8) The man holds a small orange ball, and the white dog jumps high into the air to catch it. The setting is still the sunny backyard with lush green grass and a brick perimeter wall. (9) The man opens a dark wooden front door and walks into the house. A white dog and a Yorkie follow him inside. The interior entryway has a shoe rack filled with various sneakers. (10) Returning to the bedroom, the man lies on the bed again, resuming his dramatic crying. The Yorkie dog climbs onto his chest and licks his face, causing him to eventually stop crying and look at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-pitched, dramatic sobbing and wailing from a male voice. Accompanying this is a slow-tempo, emotional orchestral piece featuring prominent, somber string instruments like violins and cellos, creating a heavy, melancholic atmosphere. (2) The sobbing intensifies with sharp, audible gasps for air and whimpering. The background music swells slightly in volume, maintaining its minor-key, dramatic tone. No environmental noise is present, suggesting a quiet indoor recording environment. (3) The music cuts out completely. A male voice speaks in a calm, instructional tone, saying 'pee pee'. This is followed by the sounds of birds chirping and a gentle outdoor wind floor, indicating a change in location. (4) The same male voice says 'poo poo' in a low-energy, neutral tone. The sound of soft, percussive paw steps on grass can be heard, along with the distant hum of an outdoor neighborhood. (5) A distinct, crinkling sound of a thin plastic bag being manipulated is heard. This is followed by the sound of a small object landing and the dogs making soft panting noises. (6) The sound of a heavy wooden door being opened with a creaking hinge is heard, followed by a sharp metallic click as the latch engages and the door closes shut. (7) The dramatic orchestral music resumes immediately. The male voice returns to loud, breathy sobbing and exaggerated crying sounds. Soft, wet licking sounds and the rustling of fabric on the bed are audible as a dog interacts with the speaker.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A humorous look at the reality of pet ownership, showing that even when one is having a 'mental breakdown,' the mundane responsibilities of caring for dogs (walking, cleaning up, playing) take precedence and interrupt the emotional moment.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a cyclic narrative to contrast high-drama performative sadness with the grounded, chore-like nature of pet care.
